_comment: The one table of WooCommerce selectors the Cart and Checkout look settings paint. Read by includes/woocommerce/commerce-look/selectors.php (the writer) and scripts/computed-route/lib/site-check-commerce-look.mjs (the drift probe). Selectors are read from the DOM WooCommerce renders on wc_version, never guessed. cart / checkout: selector list relative to the block root (a missing key means the row does not apply to that block; no comma inside a functional pseudo-class). state: prose. needs: machine-readable state for the probe (basket filled; viewport any|wide|narrow; action none|open-coupon-on-cart|tick-order-note|optional).

field_text.state: basket filled; guest; any width; on the cart the coupon panel must be open

field_select.state: basket filled; guest; any width; the country field shows once the address form is open

field_textarea.state: basket filled; the order-note checkbox ticked

field_label.state: basket filled; guest; any width; on the cart the coupon panel must be open

field_wrap.state: basket filled; guest; any width; on the cart the coupon panel must be open

item.state: basket filled; any user; any width

item_wide.state: basket filled; any user; wide cart block (WooCommerce adds is-large to the layout)

item_list.state: basket filled; any user; any width

item_header.state: basket filled; any user; wide (WooCommerce hides the header row on narrow cart blocks)

item_image.state: basket filled; any user; any width

item_image_img.state: basket filled with a product that has an image; any width

item_stepper.state: basket filled; any user; any width

item_name.state: basket filled; any user; any width (the cart name rule is table-qualified in WooCommerce's cart.css, so the row repeats it)

item_price.state: basket filled; any user; any width

summary.state: basket filled; any user; any width

summary_heading.state: basket filled; any user; checkout title shows at narrow widths only

total_row.state: basket filled; any user; any width

option.state: basket filled; a shipping zone with a rate; any width

option_chosen.state: basket filled; a shipping zone with a rate; any width

notice.state: a notice is showing (an invalid coupon, a stock message) or a commerce note is placed

terms.state: basket filled; any user; any width

field_label_active.state: a field holds a value or has focus (WooCommerce adds is-active and shrinks the floating label)
